text: Carmen's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is next Thursday at St Mary's, 11am. She sounded exhausted on the phone.
Rohan got into Leeds for medicine!! starts September 2027. His mum was in tears apparently
ali made redundant friday. whole team gone. he's ok-ish, says he'll take a month off before looking
Need to send Seo-yeon a card, her grandma's funeral is this Saturday
Nikhil supports Spurs, season ticket holder since he was about ten. Hates when people bring up the 2019 final lol

So Asha and Ricardo have split up. She told me over coffee, they'd been together six years. She's staying in the flat in Walthamstow and he's moved back to his brother's. She seemed calmer than I expected but said the evenings are the worst. Check in with her next week, maybe take her out for dinner somewhere.
Teresa's little girl starts reception on Monday. Teresa is more nervous than the kid is
anjali graduating 2 November 2026 - masters in architecture. dont forget to get her something, she mentioned wanting a proper drafting lamp
Ebony's into crochet in a big way now, making amigurumi for the whole office. Did a little octopus for Chiara's desk.
Lachlan's sitting his driving test tomorrow morning, third attempt. Really nervous. Text him good luck tonight
Ellie said Ryan's nan died last week. He's not really talking about it. Funeral is in Cork, they fly out Wednesday
Pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax before the 31st

Oliver plays bass in a covers band called The Loose Ends, mostly 90s Britpop and a bit of Motown. They rehearse every Wednesday in his mate's garage in Bedminster and he's just bought a new Fender Precision which he would not stop talking about. Gig at the Fleece on Saturday 14 November 2026, he said come along and bring people. First proper headline slot for them.

Joseph lost his job today. They called it a restructure but basically his whole department in Reading is being shut down and moved to Krakow. He gets three months' pay. His wife Alice is due in March 2027 so the timing is awful, and they'd just started looking at bigger houses. He was trying to joke about it but you could tell he's scared. Give him a ring at the weekend, and ask Ryan if his firm is hiring.
Aurelio collects vintage Italian football shirts, mostly Serie A 80s and 90s. Birthday's in January. A Sampdoria one would blow his mind
Helen mentioned her son Noah got his GCSE mock results back - all 7s and above. She's thrilled

Uh so I just got off the phone with Delroy. His mum's funeral got moved, it's now Tuesday the 3rd instead of Friday because the crematorium had a mix up. He's doing the eulogy and he's dreading it, he's never spoken in public before. I said I'd come. I should ask him if he wants to run through it with me on Sunday.
Abebe's daughter Blessing passed her grade 5 piano!
kiri moving to Wellington in a fortnight, job at Weta. leaving drinks thurs at the Crown
Lukas and Kaito got engaged last weekend. Lukas proposed on a hike in the Lakes. Wedding probably summer 2027
Alana's cat Biscuit has to have a tooth out on Wednesday, she's weirdly anxious about the anaesthetic
Anil was let go after 22 years at the bank. He's putting a brave face on but Jasmine says he's barely sleeping. Ask Jasmine whether he'd want a visit or if it's too soon

Krisztina is obsessed with Hollow Knight, finally got the sequel and has been playing every evening, says it's the only thing that switches her brain off at the moment. Also does bouldering Tuesdays and Thursdays at the Castle and is trying to get her first V5 before Christmas. Her partner Lukas thinks she's mad but goes along to belay. She mentioned wanting new climbing shoes, La Sportiva ones.
Remind me to ring Carmen on Friday to see how the funeral went
wedding's off. Chiara and Rohan called it off last month, she only just told me. she's moved in with her sister for now
Seo-yeon's little boy finished his first week of Year 1. Loves his teacher, hates the school dinners
Ricardo's band is playing a festival in Lisbon in June 2027, very excited. He plays drums. Massive Benfica fan too
Got Ali a book on career changes. Give it to him when I see him Saturday.
Need to buy a black tie for the funeral on Thursday.
Asha's dad has his hip op on 9 December 2026. She's worried about him managing the stairs after. Must ask her nearer the time if she needs a lift to the hospital
Teresa Walsh - new neighbour at no. 42. Retired teacher, keeps bees, two grandkids in Bristol
Ebony's brother Delroy is doing the London marathon in April 2027 for a bereavement charity, in memory of their dad. Sponsor him!
Nikhil's girlfriend dumped him on Tuesday, by text. He's gutted. He's coming to the quiz Thursday, keep an eye on him
Talked to Helen about her book club. They're doing Middlemarch over three months, she loves it, her husband thinks it's mad
Lachlan PASSED!! finally. Buying his first car next month
anjali's twins start nursery next tuesday. she's back at work the week after. said she feels guilty about it
Joseph & Alice's housewarming Saturday 21st, bringing wine
Ellie - knitting a jumper for her nephew Oliver's christening. Pattern is mad complicated. She'd love the new Laine magazine, hint hint

Voice note: Kaito got a distinction in his PhD viva yesterday! Dr Ito now. Graduation ceremony is 15 July 2027, he wants us all there. Must send him something today, maybe a bottle of the Japanese whisky he likes.
Abebe's uncle died in Addis on Monday, he's flying out tomorrow for two weeks. Text him before he goes
Book the boiler service, sort out the gutters this weekend if it stays dry
Alana is a massive Swifties person, went to three Eras shows. Wants vinyl of the Tortured Poets anthology
Krisztina's mum, Mrs Yilmaz, is recovering from a stroke. Krisztina is splitting her time between here and Manchester. Lukas says she's running on empty. Should drop round a lasagne this week
Aurelio Barros aka Rel - mate of Ricardo's from five a side. Works as a sound engineer. Lives in Peckham

Blessing Okafor got her A level results today: A*AA, which is exactly what she needed. She'd been convinced she'd messed up chemistry. Off to Durham for law in October, moving into halls on the 4th. Her parents, Abebe and Kiri, are throwing a party on Saturday afternoon in the garden. Need to get her a card and something useful for uni, maybe a decent kettle or a voucher.

Right, Ryan. Made redundant from the agency, effective end of November, after nearly eight years there. He saw it coming, he said, they lost the two biggest clients over the summer. But he's already got an interview with a fintech startup on Monday at 2, second round, and he sounds weirdly upbeat. He's been teaching himself Python in the evenings. His girlfriend Ellie is less calm about it than he is. Ask him how it went on Tuesday.
Anil and Jasmine celebrating 30 years married on 12 December 2026, big do at the golf club. Need to RSVP by Friday
chatted to Oliver on the train. he's writing a fantasy novel, 80k words in. loves Le Guin and Pratchett

Carmen said her mum has moved in with them since the funeral. It's a lot. Her mum's not coping and Carmen's trying to keep work going on top. She's off for a week from Monday. I should see if she'd like to go for a walk on Wednesday.
Kiri's son passed his black belt grading on Sunday. He's nine!
Seo-yeon is in a pottery class on Wednesday nights. Making a full dinner set, she's on bowl number 4 of 12
Nikhil asked if I wanted his spare tickets for the Arsenal game next Saturday. Told him yes, I'm driving us both
Teresa's grandson's first day at secondary was today. She rang me about it, so proud. I'll send her the photo from the summer
Gym 7am tomorrow, then dentist at 10.30. Groceries after
Rohan got the call this morning: his godfather passed away overnight. They were really close. Funeral details to follow, probably the week of 16 November. Take him for a pint once things settle
Helen's daughter Alice doing her Duke of Edinburgh gold expedition in the Cairngorms this weekend. Helen's a wreck about it, Alice is totally fine

Ebony said Chiara's grandad, who everyone calls Nonno, turns 90 on Sunday. Massive party in Bergamo, the whole family is flying over Friday and coming back Tuesday. Chiara's organising a video of messages from all the cousins and asked if I'd record a little hello since I met him at her graduation in 2024. Do that by Thursday. He loves Atalanta, so maybe mention the cup run.
Delroy finished the eulogy, said it went fine in the end. His aunt asked for a copy. Follow up with him next week, see how he's holding up
Jasmine has started learning the cello at 52! Lessons every Monday, practising 30 mins a day. Her teacher says she's got a good ear
Lukas's mum's retirement do is on the 28th. He's organising it and is stressed. He wants help choosing a photo book; remind me to send him that site I used
